messages:
Alex (ENG-MGR): hey team — quick question about the promotion packet deadline. we want to promote Priya to L4 with comp change effective 4/1. is that still possible?
Samantha (People Ops): short answer: yes if the packet lands with all required docs by EOD next Wednesday (payroll cutoff). otherwise pay change moves to next cycle. :calendar:
Alex (ENG-MGR): what exactly do you need in the packet? i have manager rationale but i want to avoid back-and-forth.
Samantha (People Ops): please include: 1) short promo rationale (3 bullets) + examples, 2) updated role profile, 3) most recent manager doc + 1 peer review example, 4) target comp (base + bonus %, equity ask separate), 5) requested effective date.
Alex (ENG-MGR): any file template?
Maria (People Ops Ops): yep — use the "Promotion Evidence Pack" template in the HR doc portal: https://redwood.example.com/internal/promo-template (use the filled example for engineering). rename file as "promo_PRIYA_lastname_MgrName.pdf".
Alex (ENG-MGR): got it. on effective date: can we backdate to 4/1 but leave payroll change until next cycle? asking because product wants credit for Q2 headcount.
Samantha (People Ops): two separate things: title/level change can be recorded with effective date 4/1 in HRIS, but retroactive pay requires payroll entry before cutoff. if payroll misses cutoff, pay will be effective next pay period. we can still record level change for headcount tracking.
Ben (Payroll): confirm — cutoff for retro pay is next Friday EOD PT. any comp-change forms after that go into next month's payroll run. if you need retro pay we need the signed comp-change form + manager approval by cutoff.
Ken (Director ENG): flag — comp is above band midpoint, do we need calibration or exec approval?
Samantha (People Ops): if the proposed base exceeds the band max for L4, you'll need a short exception note and sign-off from compensation (cc: me and 'comp-approvals@redwood.com'). for numbers between midpoint and band max we just document justification in the packet and discuss in calibration.
Alex (ENG-MGR): calibration meeting timing?
Maria (People Ops Ops): engineering calibration is Thursday 3pm weekly this month. bring the packet to the doc folder by Tuesday EOD to be added to the agenda.
Alex (ENG-MGR): is there a preferred evidence format? screenshots of PRs / link to notable commits okay?
Samantha (People Ops): yes — links to PRs, customer impact metrics, OKR contributions are helpful. small quoted excerpts from peer feedback are best, not a full transcript.
Alex (ENG-MGR): any wording suggestions for the manager rationale?
Samantha (People Ops): try: "Impact: delivered X feature that reduced latency by Y%. Scope: owned cross-team design & rollout. Leadership: mentored two ICs and led oncall ops for Q4." short, measurable, role-aligned.
Alex (ENG-MGR): thanks. how do we handle the promotion announcement to the individual and the team?
peopleops-bot: Reminder: do not announce promotions publicly before People Ops confirms payroll sweep.
Samantha (People Ops): we prefer People Ops to send the offer/notice to employee once HRIS + payroll dates are locked. managers can have a 1:1 heads-up but avoid broad team messages until we confirm.
Ken (Director ENG): what about retroactive equity grants?
Samantha (People Ops): equity is a separate flow — comp packet does not automatically trigger grants. submit a separate equity request via the grants form; comp approval helps prioritize it.
Ben (Payroll): small operational note: include the employee's PeopleSoft ID in the packet to avoid name collisions.
Alex (ENG-MGR): one last thing — if the promotion is part of a role transfer (two teams), any differences?
Maria (People Ops Ops): if it's a lateral transfer plus promotion, include both manager approvals and the transfer ticket number. use the "promo+transfer" checkbox on the form.
Alex (ENG-MGR): perfect, i'll assemble the packet and drop in the folder. thanks all. :thumbsup:
Samantha (People Ops): thanks — ping me if you want a quick review before submission.
Maria (People Ops Ops): added checklist snippet for copy/paste:
```
- Promo packet (template)
- Manager rationale (3 bullets)
- 2 example contributions (PRs/metrics)
- Peer feedback excerpt
- Proposed comp & effective date
- PeopleSoft ID + manager approval
- Any comp-exception note (if > band max)
```
Alex (ENG-MGR): copying that into my notes now.
Samantha (People Ops): closing loop: if packet arrives by Wed EOD we aim for 4/1 HRIS effective date and retro pay on next payroll if Ben confirms. otherwise level change will still be recorded but pay shifts.
Ben (Payroll): will confirm payroll timeline after final numbers.
Alex (ENG-MGR): great — will submit by Tue EOD. thanks everyone.
Samantha (People Ops): :white_check_mark:
